import sys

def explore(position, current_value, total_cost):
    global minimal, A, B
    if total_cost >= minimal:
        return
    if position == 0:
        if current_value == 0:
            minimal = total_cost
        return
    quotient = current_value // A[position]
    delta_neg = abs(quotient) - 1
    if quotient < 0:
        delta_neg = -delta_neg
    delta_pos = abs(quotient) + 1
    if quotient < 0:
        delta_pos = -delta_pos

    explore(position - 1, current_value - quotient * B[position], total_cost + abs(quotient) * position)
    explore(position - 1, current_value - delta_neg * B[position], total_cost + abs(delta_neg) * position)
    explore(position - 1, current_value - delta_pos * B[position], total_cost + abs(delta_pos) * position)

def main():
    global minimal, A, B
    B = [0] * 21
    for i in range(1, 17):
        B[i] = B[i - 1] * 10 + 1
    A = [0] * 17
    A[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, 17):
        A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10
    n = int(sys.stdin.read())
    temp_num = n
    digit_count = 0
    while temp_num:
        digit_count += 1
        temp_num //= 10
    minimal = 10**18
    explore(digit_count, n, 0)
    explore(digit_count, B[digit_count + 1] - n, digit_count + 1)
    print(minimal)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
